summary: CR-485 frontend verification of Daily Report (/reports/audit) column layout on Settled, All Orders and Cancelled tabs at 1920px and 1280px. I measured bounding boxes with JS. On Settled (45 rows, 41 with actions, at 1280 and 1920), the ₹ Amount span did not overlap any Change/Unpaid/Print pill in any row. No cell spilled into the next one, the action pills stayed inside the actions cell, and no amount was truncated (the longest was ₹1,859.02). Header cells line up with row cells (left offset and width within 1px) on all 3 tabs. Print is clickable: it shows the 'Bill request sent' toast and does not open the row drawer. Change/Unpaid are disabled on older dates with the tooltip 'Only available for today and yesterday', which is expected. I could not test them enabled because today and yesterday have 0 orders. The CR-485 fix works. Separately, I found a race condition when changing dates (it was there before this change and is not part of CR-485), plus a few minor layout issues.

ui_bugs.issue: PRE-EXISTING race condition, outside CR-485. The order-logs-report call takes about 5-10s. If the user clicks the date picker prev/next arrow more than once, older responses arrive late and overwrite the data for the date now selected. I saw this in testing: the picker showed 'Oct 28, 2026' while the tab counts changed 70→66→52 as responses for other dates landed. The Print toast was for order #023021 while the top row shown was #022899. fetchOrders (L229) has no AbortController or 'latest request wins' guard on selectedDate.

issues: Because the columns are narrower, the 'TABLE NO' (w-20) and 'PUNCHED BY' (w-24) header labels wrap onto 2 lines (37px tall vs 24px for the others).
The PUNCHED BY sort icon sits right against the 'ACTIONED BY' label with no gap.

The table is wider than its container (1168px content in a 1144px container), so the AMOUNT header and values are cut off at the right edge ('AMOUN', '₹28'). The user has to scroll sideways and there is no visible hint. The Cancelled column set (columnsWithoutPayment: actionedBy w-36, amount w-32, plus Reason and Status) was not tightened in CR-485.
The table only uses about 60% of the card width, leaving a large empty area to the right of the action pills. Consider making columns flex/grow at wide viewports.

action_items: Optional (outside CR-485): add a stale-response guard in AllOrdersReportPage.fetchOrders, using a request counter or AbortController keyed on selectedDate, so late responses for earlier dates cannot overwrite the current date's data.
Minor: tighten or rebalance columnsWithoutPayment (Cancelled tab) so AMOUNT is not clipped at 1280px.
Minor: add whitespace-nowrap to header labels, or widen the TABLE NO/PUNCHED BY columns slightly, so the headers stay on one line.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderTable.jsx: the CR-485 changes are correct. overflow-hidden on both header and row cells, plus truncate on the amount span, stops amounts from spilling into neighbouring cells.
AllOrdersReportPage.jsx is 1139 lines; consider splitting it.
fetchOrders has no cancellation for in-flight requests (see the HIGH ui_bug).
seed_data_creation: None. The only side effect: one Print Bill request was sent for an old order (#023021, Oct 28 data).
